mechanics.claim: Dance of Arrows resets Lamb's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Dance of Arrows {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Lamb's''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: Fires an arrow at up to 3 nearby visible enemies, each dealing the listed physical damage; her current attack target is prioritized.
mechanics.quote: firing an arrow at up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies that deals {{as|physical damage}}. Her current attack target within any proximity will be prioritized by one of the arrows.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown is reduced to the static cooldown amount while Lamb is within Wolf's Frenzy's area, or by casting Wolf's Frenzy.
mechanics.quote: ''Dance of Arrows' '' {{sti|'''total''' cooldown}} is reduced to an amount while '''Lamb''' is within the area of ''{{ai|Wolf's Frenzy|Kindred}}''. Casting ''{{ai|Wolf's Frenzy|Kindred}}'' reduces ''Dance of Arrows' '' '''current''' cooldown to the same amount.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown reduction will not apply if it cannot actually reduce the current cooldown (current cooldown must exceed the static amount).
mechanics.quote: The {{sti|cooldown}} will not be modified if it cannot be reduced (the current cooldown would have to be less than the reduction amount in this case).

mechanics.claim: Lamb can cast any of her abilities during the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Lamb''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.
